1: A small snowy colonial street at dusk in front of an old low stone stable with a plain wooden door: a French woman of about thirty-eight with an oval face, calm dark eyes, strong dark brows and dark hair under a white linen coif, in a plain dark wool gown, white collar and a dark shawl, stands in three-quarter view with her face clearly visible, listening to a weathered man of about forty-five in a dark soldier-governor's coat and wide hat who gestures toward the stable; hard side light, mist, log houses behind. No other people. No children.
3: The bare interior of an old stone stable at dusk, rough stone walls, wooden beams, a shaft of hard light from a small window across straw and packed earth: a French woman of about thirty-eight with an oval face, calm dark eyes, strong dark brows and dark hair under a white linen coif, in a plain dark wool gown, white collar and a dark shawl, alone, arranges a long plain wooden bench with both hands, her face clearly visible in three-quarter view, quietly determined. No other people. No children.
4: A bare seventeenth-century schoolroom made from a stone stable, plain benches in rows, a slate propped against the wall, a shaft of light from a small window: a French woman of about thirty-eight with an oval face, calm dark eyes, strong dark brows and dark hair under a white linen coif, in a plain dark wool gown, white collar and a dark shawl, alone, lights a single candle on a small wooden table, her face clearly visible in three-quarter view, solemn and still. No other people, no children.
6: The open door of an old stone stable turned school, snowy street and log houses outside at dusk, mist: a French woman of about thirty-eight with an oval face, calm dark eyes, strong dark brows and dark hair under a white linen coif, in a plain dark wool gown, white collar and a dark shawl, stands at the door with one hand on the frame looking out, her face clearly visible in three-quarter view, calm and resolute, hard low light. No other people. No children.
8: A rough window in a stone schoolroom at night: a French woman of about thirty-eight with an oval face, calm dark eyes, strong dark brows and dark hair under a white linen coif, in a plain dark wool gown, white collar and a dark shawl, stands at it with one hand on the shutter looking out toward the far river, where a tiny lantern of an arriving ship glows in the mist; her face clearly visible in three-quarter view, thoughtful. No other people. No children.
